hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' 2>/dev/null); [[ "$f" == *.sh ]] && { h=$(head -1 "$f" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$h" | grep -q 'zsh'; then zsh -n "$f" 2>&1 && echo '{"suppressOutput":true}' || echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"Syntax error in $f (zsh -n failed)\"}"; else bash -n "$f" 2>&1 && echo '{"suppressOutput":true}' || echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"Syntax error in $f (bash -n failed)\"}"; fi; } || echo '{"suppressOutput":true}'
